Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11 operating systems and enterprise desktop environments. Experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications and services. Working knowledge of Active Directory, user/group administration, permissions, and authentication. Experience troubleshooting computer hardware, software, peripherals, and network connectivity. Familiarity with IT service management and ticketing platforms such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or similar systems. Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, wired, and wireless networking. Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues using a logical and systematic approach. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Strong customer-service skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical users. Ability to prioritize multiple incidents and requests in a fast-paced environment. Ability to document troubleshooting procedures and technical solutions clearly and accurately. Preferred Qualifications Associate's or bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Experience supporting Citrix Workspace, Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, VDI, or thin-client environments. Experience with endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune, ManageEngine Endpoint Central, SCCM/MECM, or similar technologies. Experience supporting Cisco Webex, Microsoft Teams Rooms, or other enterprise conferencing technologies. Experience with Jira Service Management or other ITSM platforms. Familiarity with PowerShell or other scripting/automation technologies. CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft, Citrix, or similar industry certifications. Ability to work independently with limited supervision. Ownership and accountability for assigned incidents and requests. Ability to determine when an issue should be escalated to another technical team. Strong attention to detail and documentation. Professional communication and customer-service skills. Ability to effectively communicate with employees at all levels of the organization. Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously develop technical skills. Ability to mentor junior technicians and share technical knowledge with the team. The position requires both strong technical ability and a high level of ownership, professionalism, and customer service.
